raw.name: Earth Eye

dictionary.lore: A crystal with the power of earth. It has a rich emerald color and enhances the cleanliness of its carrier. It's often found in the Forest of Beasts in the Mistral region, where the Tree Spirit's power is high. Synthesizing it with a Fate Stone or a Paladin Stone creates earth-enhancing tools.
